pr_title: Propagating nested inner_hits to the parent compound retriever
pr_body:
In this PR we update the `RankDocsQueryBuilder` so that any inner hits that were requested as part of any sub-retriever are propagated to the top-level compound retriever, and that (as an optimization) `inner_hit` computation is disabled for anything but the top-level retriever.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/116397

issue_context.title: Missing inner_hits from the top-level results in a compound retriever

review_comments:
Should we rely on the fact that the compound retriever will always set this? I mean why do we need to set this on the knn and standard retriever too? 
We should also ensure that implementations of the `CompoundRetrieverBuilder` calls `super.createSourceBuilder` first if they want to modify the source builder. `TextSimilarityRankRetrieverBuilder` does it own thing and already diverged (missing the shard id sort and now this new skip inner hits).
That's a fair point! Will update to ensure that the parent `createSourceBuilder` will always be called, and remove the checks from the individual retrievers.
